name: Painted parallax layers
oneLiner: The flat background of a side-view HD game becomes 3-5 hand-painted layers (far sky and ridges, drifting clouds, mid hills, near silhouettes, and an opaque under-strip of forest floor that fills pits when the game's ground is higher than the painted one) generated once at build time in one locked style, post-processed so each repeats sideways without a seam (best-cut search + premultiplied cross-fade; mid and near are two panels joined into a strip about 3 screens wide), scrolled at their own depth with an atmospheric tint per layer; the game loads the files once and keeps its old flat layer as the fallback for any missing image.
notFor: pixel-art styles (pixel8, pixel16, handheld4): painted layers look out of place next to pixel tiles (use I-02 parallax-layers)
top-down, isometric and pseudo-3D games (no side view)
backgrounds that must change at runtime (no generator is called by the game)
exact reproduction of a look by prompt alone (there is no seed)

needs: GameDNA_Assets (L-00 loader) loaded first; the game's boot moved into its onReady callback
camera offset in world px (x, optionally y) from the game's draw pass
fixed step to advance the cloud-drift clock (the same step ?t= fast-forward runs)
draw slot before tiles and sprites (where the old background was drawn); the old layer functions as fallbacks
provides: painted backdrop for the play field (roles far, clouds, mid, near; optional back) with the I-02 scroll factors
lastDrawn() / layers(): offsets, factors, panel joins (for tests)
assets.json manifest: prompt, GEN.md, model, date and sha256 of every shipped layer; style lock + key painting
postproc.py hrepeat seam / join / roll / hstrip, assetcheck bg-layer rule, seamcheck.py

promptParams.default: far, clouds, mid (2 panels), near (2 panels), under (2 panels)
where the game's ground starts, as a fraction of the view height

assets: module/painted-parallax.js: GameDNA_PaintedParallax (one global, no dependencies; uses GameDNA_Assets from L-00)
assets/assets.json: 12 generated files (WebP, 576 KB): dusk + night far, clouds, mid, under, near and the two style keys, with prompts, GEN.md, meta and sha256 per Codex run under assets/gen/
assets/prompts/: style lock, night paragraph, every brief, templates.md
tools/assets (shared): gen.sh, postproc.py (hrepeat seam, join), assetcheck.py (bg-layer rule)
skinSpec: v0.5 bitmap roles: entries carry skinRole {role: bg-layer, kind: <layer>}
related: parallax-layers (I-02): same roles and factors, code-drawn pixel layers
